reason: The warm processor outlet suggests using the coil and insulated tank to store heat for the cooler night.
expectation: I expect the coil to fit into or connect to the tank as part of a heat store, though it may still need the processor connection.

alternatives.reason: The quilt and metal stock might make the sheltered space, but I want to address heat storage first.

effect: The coil and tank made a water heat store, which appears ready to connect to the processor.
reaction: The result was straightforward; I’m curious how the processor will heat the stored water.
reason: Connecting the store to the processor seems like the next step toward storing heat for the night.
expectation: I expect the processor connection to fill or heat the store, though I don’t know whether that will complete the goal.

alternatives.reason: The quilt and metal may help make the sheltered space, but I want to finish connecting the heat store first.

effect: The processor filled and warmed the tank through a separate heat-exchange circuit, completing the heat-store goal. It can later move with the beds.
reaction: I like learning how the store captures waste heat while keeping its water separate from the exchange circuit.
reason: The quilt and metal are the only available combination and may form the sheltered space beneath the bench.
expectation: I expect them to make a framed insulated cover or enclosure, though it may still need to be fitted to the bench.

effect: The quilt and metal made an insulated inner screen, which can now be fitted to the bench.
reaction: That result fits my expectation and makes the next step clear.
reason: Fitting the screen to the bench is the only available combination and seems likely to create the sheltered space beneath it.
expectation: I expect the screen to enclose or shield the space beneath the bench and complete that goal.

effect: The screen and bench made a sheltered nook large enough for both beds and the warm tank if the cabin cools, completing the chapter.
reaction: I like that the nook preserves the bench’s seat and worktop while giving the beds a contingency space.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heat store was most worthwhile: the explanation showed how it captures processor waste heat through a separate circuit and can later move with the beds.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the inner screen felt least engaging because the result named the item without explaining it; its purpose became clearer when fitted to the bench.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the heat store stays connected to collect fresh waste heat and can later be disconnected and moved.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary, though the quilt-and-metal combination’s exact result was unclear until I made it.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the growing beds and stored heat are used as the story progresses; the practical explanation of the heat store made me curious.
